use default

luhn(number: string) -> bool is
    let total =
        number
            |> reverse()
            |> index()
            |> map(entry =>
                (
                    let digit = cast int(entry.value) - cast int('0')

                    if entry.index % 2 == 0 then
                        digit
                    else
                        let doubled = digit * 2

                        if doubled > 9 then doubled - 9 else doubled fi
                    fi
                ))
            |> reduce(0, (running, digit) => running + digit)

    return total % 10 == 0
si

let numbers = [
    "49927398716",
    "49927398717",
    "1234567812345678",
    "1234567812345670"
]

for number in numbers do
    let verdict = if luhn(number) then "valid" else "invalid" fi

    write_line("{number,-18} {verdict}")
od
